formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   x1.size ≤ (27 : ℕ) →     PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (14 : ℕ) x1 →       (∀ x4 < x1.size, PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x4 (0 : Fin (2 : ℕ)) ≠ PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x4 (1 : Fin (2 : ℕ))) →         (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x1 (0 : ℕ)).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →           (∀ (x6 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x6) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x7 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) (x8 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), (x7 = x8 ∨ x7 = x8 + (1 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) ∨ x7 = x8 + (3 : Fin (7 : ℕ))) ∧ x6 (Fin.castAdd (7 : ℕ) x7) = Bool.true ∧ x6 (Fin.natAdd (7 : ℕ) x8) = Bool.true) →             (∀ (x7 : Bool),                 ∃ (x8 : ℕ → Bool),                   have x9 : List Bool := x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x9 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x9 = if x7 = Bool.true then (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) else (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ))));                   (∀ x10 < (14 : ℕ), x8 x10 = Decidable.decide (x10 = if x7 = Bool.true then (7 : ℕ) else (0 : ℕ))) ∧                     (∀ x10 < x1.size,                         have x12 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x1 x10;                         have x13 : ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x10 (0 : Fin (2 : ℕ));                         have x14 : ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x10 (1 : Fin (2 : ℕ));                         (x12.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x8 ((14 : ℕ) + x10) = (x9.getD x13 Bool.false && x8 x14 || x8 x13 && x9.getD x14 Bool.false)) ∧ (x12.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x8 ((14 : ℕ) + x10) = (x8 x13 || x8 x14))) ∧                       x8 x1.output = Bool.false) →               False
plain_statement: Fano plane, points as inputs 0 to 6 and lines as inputs 7 to 13. No circuit of at most 27 AND and OR gates, each reading two different earlier wires, whose first gate is an AND gate, computes the incidence function and has (point 0, line 7) as a double re-read incidence (reached neither reading the line once nor reading the point once).
title: A step toward: Fano plane: no circuit of at most 27 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
